span.p:
Recall precision gate (recall_episodes_ranked)
tokenize_words on non-alphanumeric runs, then drop sub-threshold
single-char tokens (MIN_CLEAN_NEEDLE_LEN=2); word-boundary prefix match
(shares_word_prefix). Empty needle set => recall NOTHING (fail-closed).
The keyword/substring search APIs (search_facts / search_episodes_by_keywords)
apply the same CLEAN vs RAW sub-threshold cut (search_facts via partition_fact_query;
search_episodes_by_keywords inline; RAW markers keep exact substring).
src/cognitive_memory/library_adapter.rs
